div.head: Af 36.2[b]
div.ab: Gif hy syn bú gelic, ord ⁊ hindeweard sceaft, ðæt sy buton pleo.
Gif hie sien bu gelic, ord ⁊ hindeweard sceaft, þæt sie butan pleo.
Si equaliter ferantur acies et cuspis, sine culpa reputetur.
Gif hie sien bu gelic, ord ⁊ hindeweard sceaft, þæt sie butan pleo.
If they are equal in height, the point and the shaft in the back, that shall not be considered danger[ous intention].
If they are both on a level, the point end and the [other] end of the shaft, the man with the spear shall not be regarded as responsible for causing danger.
Wenn sie gleich [hoch] sind, beides, Spitze und hinterer Schaft, das gelte ohne gefährliche Absicht.
If they are both equal [in height], point and rear shaft, let that count as without dangerous intent.
